def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):

def hperiod(grid):

lib='''def background(grid):
    """The most common color in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def cells_of(grid, color):
    """Positions (i, j) of every cell of the given color."""
    return [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]

def vline(grid, color):
    """The column that is the given color throughout, or None."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return next((j for j in range(W) if all(grid[i][j] == color for i in range(H))), None)

def hline(grid, color):
    """The row that is the given color throughout, or None."""
    return next((i for i in range(len(grid)) if all(v == color for v in grid[i])), None)

def paint(grid, cells, color):
    """A copy of the grid with the given positions recolored."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, j in cells:
        out[i][j] = color
    return out

def translate(cells, di, dj):
    """Every (i, j) position shifted by (di, dj)."""
    return [(i + di, j + dj) for i, j in cells]

def slide_until_adjacent(cells, line_pos, axis):
    """Shift of cells along axis so their far edge touches the line at line_pos;
    positive shift moves cells toward larger coordinates."""
    pos = [c[axis] for c in cells]
    mn, mx = min(pos), max(pos)
    if mx < line_pos:
        return line_pos - mx - 1
    if mn > line_pos:
        return -(mn - line_pos - 1)
    return 0

def full_line(length, color):
    """A whole row/column of the given color."""
    return [color] * length

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    vc=next((j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(H))),None)
    hr=next((i for i in range(H) if all(v==2 for v in g[i])),None)
    c=sorted({v for row in g for v in row}-{bg,2})[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if vc is not None:
        for i in range(H):
            js=[j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
            if not js: continue
            mn,mx=min(js),max(js)
            d = (vc-mx-1) if mx<vc else (-(mn-vc-1) if mn>vc else 0)
            for j in js: out[i][j]=bg
            for j in js: out[i][j+d]=c
        js=[j for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if out[i][j]==c]
        marker = (min(js)-1) if max(js)<vc else (max(js)+1)
        for i in range(H): out[i][marker]=8
    else:
        for j in range(W):
            iis=[i for i in range(H) if g[i][j]==c]
            if not iis: continue
            mn,mx=min(iis),max(iis)
            d = (hr-mx-1) if mx<hr else (-(mn-hr-1) if mn>hr else 0)
            for i in iis: out[i][j]=bg
            for i in iis: out[i+d][j]=c
        iis=[i for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if out[i][j]==c]
        marker = (min(iis)-1) if max(iis)<hr else (max(iis)+1)
        for j in range(W): out[marker][j]=8
    return out

import json
from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    vc=next((j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(H))),None)
    hr=next((i for i in range(H) if all(v==2 for v in g[i])),None)
    c=sorted({v for row in g for v in row}-{bg,2})[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if vc is not None:
        # rigid slide until global near edge touches
        js=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        near = max(j for _,j in js) if min(j for _,j in js)>vc else min(j for _,j in js)
        # shape side
        left = max(j for _,j in js) < vc
        base = (vc - max(j for _,j in js) - 1) if left else -(min(j for _,j in js) - vc - 1)
        cells=[(i,j+base) for i,j in js]
        # rows not touching may take 1 extra step toward line
        for i in range(H):
            rjs=[j for ii,j in cells if ii==i]
            if not rjs: continue
            if left and min(rjs)>vc-1-0 and min(rjs)>3-3: pass
        # implement: for each row, if its near edge is not adjacent to line and is within 1 step, move 1
        cellset={}
        for i,j in cells: cellset.setdefault(i,[]).append(j)
        newcells=[]
        for i,rr in cellset.items():
            rr=sorted(rr)
            if left and min(rr)>vc-1 and min(rr)-(vc-1)<=1:
                rr=[j-1 for j in rr]
            if (not left) and max(rr)<vc+1 and (vc+1)-max(rr)<=1:
                rr=[j+1 for j in rr]
            newcells+= [(i,j) for j in rr]
        out=paint=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
        for i,j in newcells: out[i][j]=c
        for i in range(H): out[i][vc]=2
        mn=min(j for _,j in newcells); mx=max(j for _,j in newcells)
        marker = mn-1 if mx<vc else mx+1
        for i in range(H): out[i][marker]=8
        return out
    else:
        js=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        above = max(i for i,_ in js) < hr
        base = (hr - max(i for i,_ in js) - 1) if above else -(min(i for i,_ in js) - hr - 1)
        cellset={}
        for i,j in js: cellset.setdefault(j,[]).append(i+base)
        newcells=[]
        for j,cc in cellset.items():
            cc=sorted(cc)
            if above and max(cc)<hr-1 and (hr-1)-max(cc)<=1:
                cc=[i+1 for i in cc]
            if (not above) and min(cc)>hr+1 and min(cc)-(hr+1)<=1:
                cc=[i-1 for i in cc]
            newcells+=[(i,j) for i in cc]
        out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
        for i,j in newcells: out[i][j]=c
        for j in range(W): out[hr][j]=2
        mn=min(i for i,_ in newcells); mx=max(i for i,_ in newcells)
        marker = mn-1 if mx<hr else mx+1
        for j in range(W): out[marker][j]=8
        return out

def transform(grid):
    """Slide the shape perpendicular to the 2-line toward it, per row/column,
    each shift capped in magnitude by the previous row/column's shift; then draw
    a full 8-line adjacent to the shape on the side away from the 2-line."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = lib.background(grid)
    vc, hr = lib.vline(grid, 2), lib.hline(grid, 2)
    c = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row} - {bg, 2})[0]
    cells = lib.cells_of(grid, c)
    vert = vc is not None
    line = vc if vert else hr
    axis = 1 if vert else 0
    other = [i for i, j in cells] if vert else [j for i, j in cells]
    order = sorted(set(other))
    def touch(k):  # shift for the slice at line-coordinate k so its far edge touches
        pos = [j for i, j in cells if (i == k if vert else j == k)]
        mn, mx = min(pos), max(pos)
        if mx < line: return line - mx - 1
        if mn > line: return -(mn - line - 1)
        return 0
    shifts, cap = {}, None
    for k in order:
        s = touch(k)
        if cap is not None:
            s = (max(s, -cap) if s < 0 else min(s, cap)) if cap is not None else s
        shifts[k] = s
        cap = abs(s) if cap is None else min(cap, abs(s))
    moved = []
    for i, j in cells:
        k = i if vert else j
        moved.append((i, j + shifts[k]) if vert else (i + shifts[k], j))
    far = (min(j for _, j in moved) - 1) if max(j for _, j in moved) < line else (max(j for _, j in moved) + 1)
    if not vert:
        far_i = (min(i for i, _ in moved) - 1) if max(i for i, _ in moved) < line else (max(i for i, _ in moved) + 1)
    out = lib.paint(grid, cells, bg)
    out = lib.paint(out, moved, c)
    marker = [(i, far) for i in range(H)] if vert else [(far_i, j) for j in range(W)]
    return lib.paint(out, marker, 8)

def transform(grid):
    """Slide the shape perpendicular to the 2-line toward it, per row/column,
    each shift capped in magnitude by the previous row/column's shift; then draw
    a full 8-line adjacent to the shape on the side away from the 2-line."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = lib.background(grid)
    vc, hr = lib.vline(grid, 2), lib.hline(grid, 2)
    c = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row} - {bg, 2})[0]
    cells = lib.cells_of(grid, c)
    vert = vc is not None
    line = vc if vert else hr
    keys = sorted({(i if vert else j) for i, j in cells})
    def touch(k):
        pos = [j for i, j in cells if (i == k if vert else j == k)]
        mn, mx = min(pos), max(pos)
        if mx < line: return line - mx - 1
        if mn > line: return -(mn - line - 1)
        return 0
    shifts, cap = {}, None
    for k in keys:
        s = touch(k)
        if cap is not None:
            s = max(s, -cap) if s < 0 else min(s, cap)
        shifts[k] = s
        cap = abs(s) if cap is None else min(cap, abs(s))
    moved = [((i, j + shifts[i]) if vert else (i + shifts[j], j)) for i, j in cells]
    ps = [j for _, j in moved] if vert else [i for i, _ in moved]
    far = (min(ps) - 1) if max(ps) < line else (max(ps) + 1)
    out = lib.paint(lib.paint(grid, cells, bg), moved, c)
    marker = [(i, far) for i in range(H)] if vert else [(far, j) for j in range(W)]

def transform(grid):
    """Slide the shape perpendicular to the 2-line toward it, per row/column,
    each shift capped in magnitude by the previous row/column's shift; then draw
    a full 8-line adjacent to the shape on the side away from the 2-line."""
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = lib.background(grid)
    vc, hr = lib.vline(grid, 2), lib.hline(grid, 2)
    c = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row} - {bg, 2})[0]
    cells = lib.cells_of(grid, c)
    vert = vc is not None
    line = vc if vert else hr
    keys = sorted({(i if vert else j) for i, j in cells})
    def touch(k):
        pos = [(j if vert else i) for i, j in cells if (i == k if vert else j == k)]
        mn, mx = min(pos), max(pos)
        if mx < line: return line - mx - 1
        if mn > line: return -(mn - line - 1)
        return 0
    shifts, cap = {}, None
    for k in keys:
        s = touch(k)
        if cap is not None:
            s = max(s, -cap) if s < 0 else min(s, cap)
        shifts[k] = s
        cap = abs(s) if cap is None else min(cap, abs(s))
    moved = [((i, j + shifts[i]) if vert else (i + shifts[j], j)) for i, j in cells]
    ps = [j for _, j in moved] if vert else [i for i, _ in moved]
    far = (min(ps) - 1) if max(ps) < line else (max(ps) + 1)
    out = lib.paint(lib.paint(grid, cells, bg), moved, c)
    marker = [(i, far) for i in range(H)] if vert else [(far, j) for j in range(W)]
    return lib.paint(out, marker, 8)

for n,p in enumerate(pairs,1):
    print(n, transform(p['input'])==p['output'])
